1-1: Brandt walks you to bench 14 and taps the gauge. "Needle in the green, you press. Green is tolerance. Anything else is scrap, and scrap isn't paid."
"Forty a shift. The press wears as you work. When it runs hot, oil it. If it seizes, you wait for the fitter, and the fitter is never quick."
1-2: A stack of empty crates by the loading door. Fresh stencil on the lids.
default: The bell. Brandt is already at his desk with the clipboard.
Steam on the windows. Somebody at bench 9 is whistling, badly.
The press is cold for the first few strokes. Then it isn't.
The radio in Brandt's office is turned low. Marching music, then the news.

events.jam: The ram seizes with a bang. Somebody shouts for the fitter.
events.jamClear: The fitter wipes his hands on his trousers and walks off without a word.
events.oil: You work the oil can into the guides. The ram slides easier.
events.wearHigh: The press is running hot. The needle shudders.
events.quotaMet: Quota. Brandt makes a mark on his clipboard.

beat: Brandt chalks the number on the board and, after a moment, underlines it.
"Bench 14." Brandt writes it in his book. "That's how it's done."
met: Brandt looks into the crate, nods, and moves on to bench 15.
"Quota." Brandt doesn't look up from the clipboard.
missed: Brandt looks into the crate. "{quota}, not {good}. There are men waiting for your bench."
"Short again?" Brandt makes a note. He doesn't say what it is.
underMinimum: Brandt counts twice. "{good}. The inspectors read these numbers too."
Brandt holds up the tally sheet so you can see it. He doesn't say anything.
